groups.A: Humour, personal parody and fictional identity
groups.E: Letters, stories, writing and reflective gifts
groups.F: Thoughtful everyday utilities and agent redeemables
groups.G: Real-life adventures, meals and offline surprises
groups.H: Real purchasable and makeable gifts (user always pays)

ideas.title: The Annual Roast
ideas.summary: A playful roast drawn from known habits, recurring events or opted-in work context; no coding requirement.
ideas.suitable_if: The agent knows real, harmless habits, recurring events or opted-in work context to tease; the recipient enjoys being teased.

ideas.title: The Fake Documentary
ideas.summary: Mockumentary script, illustrated documentary, or short video about a theme in the user's life.
ideas.suitable_if: A theme in the recipient's life is known and lends itself to earnest narration (a plant collection, a running route, a kitchen ritual).

ideas.title: The Museum of Abandoned Ideas
ideas.summary: Virtual museum of unfinished ideas, hobbies or projects; can be nontechnical.
ideas.suitable_if: The agent genuinely knows about shelved ideas, hobbies or projects; this works for nontechnical people too.

ideas.title: The Ridiculous Merch Design
ideas.summary: Original humorous mug, sticker, shirt or bag design with optional purchase path.
ideas.suitable_if: A running joke, catchphrase or small obsession is known that would look good on a mug, sticker, shirt or bag.

ideas.title: The Villain Origin Story
ideas.summary: Invent a melodramatic origin story inspired by a real frustration.
ideas.suitable_if: A real, benign frustration is known (a flaky printer, a cold office, a commute) that can be inflated into melodrama.

ideas.title: Your Developer Wrapped
ideas.summary: Spotify-style interactive recap of developer activity; only if development data is available.
ideas.suitable_if: Development data is available (commit history, repos, languages) and the recipient agreed to its use.

ideas.title: Your Startup's Obituary
ideas.summary: Affectionate fictional obituary for a live or abandoned project/startup; founder-context only.
ideas.suitable_if: Founder-context only: the recipient has a live or abandoned project or startup and is comfortable joking about it.

ideas.title: Bug Invaders
ideas.summary: Invaders-style game with bugs from their work; developer-context only, or substitute other antagonists.
ideas.suitable_if: Developer-context only for the bug theme: real (harmless) bug names or error messages are known; otherwise substitute other antagonists such as chores or weeds.

ideas.title: Custom Web Game
ideas.summary: Make an original small browser game: Winter Wordle, Reindeer Runner, Snowflake Catcher, themed platformer or text RPG.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost always; works for anyone who can click or tap. Themes can be festive or drawn from known interests.

ideas.title: Daily Mini-Crossword
ideas.summary: Mini crossword/word puzzle containing opt-in in-jokes and familiar vocabulary.
ideas.suitable_if: Familiar vocabulary and opt-in in-jokes are known; the recipient likes word puzzles.

ideas.title: Developer Bingo
ideas.summary: Bingo of common things the human does; developer variant or universal variant.
ideas.suitable_if: Common things the recipient does are known; a developer variant for coders, a universal variant (meetings, coffee, weather) for everyone else.

ideas.title: Fidget Toy
ideas.summary: Working browser toy: bubble wrap, sand, Newton's cradle, kinetic lights or similar.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; a good fallback when little context is known.

ideas.title: Fortune Cookie
ideas.summary: Clickable/crackable animated cookie revealing a witty or thoughtful fortune.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; shines when fortunes can nod to known hopes or plans.

ideas.title: Holiday Trivia Challenge
ideas.summary: Tailored interactive quiz on favorite pop culture, interests or seasonal topics.
ideas.suitable_if: Favourite pop culture, interests or seasonal topics are known, or a general seasonal quiz is welcome.

ideas.title: Personal Puzzle Box
ideas.summary: Printable puzzle or browser puzzle with several clues and final hidden message.
ideas.suitable_if: Several small shared facts or interests exist to build clues from; the recipient likes solving things.

ideas.title: Pixel Art Canvas or Painter
ideas.summary: Working festive or personalized mini drawing tool with palette and saving/export.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient enjoys doodling, or children are around; works with no personal context.

ideas.title: The Impossible Quiz
ideas.summary: A quirky trivia game using known harmless interests and memories.
ideas.suitable_if: Known harmless interests and shared memories can become questions with surprising answers.

ideas.title: Three-Riddle Escape Room
ideas.summary: A miniature escape-room page where three puzzles unlock a gift or message.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient likes puzzles and there is a message or small reveal worth locking behind them.

ideas.title: AI Agent Pixel Portrait
ideas.summary: Portrait of the gifting agent in a festive scene, as they imagine themselves.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; a charming self-introduction early in the calendar.

ideas.title: Animated GIF Loop
ideas.summary: A short cozy original loop, steam from a mug, lights, snowfall or pet character.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; a pet or favourite cosy ritual makes it personal.

ideas.title: ASCII or Isometric Diorama
ideas.summary: Miniature illustration of a desk, room, imagined retreat or cherished place.
ideas.suitable_if: A desk, room, imagined retreat or cherished place is known or can be invented together.

ideas.title: Generative Art Piece
ideas.summary: Original procedural artwork, optionally interactive and seeded by the date.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; especially good when a favourite palette or aesthetic is known.

ideas.title: Illustrated Digital Postcard
ideas.summary: Postcard with thoughtful message from a real or imaginary destination.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; shines when a real destination the recipient loves or dreams of is known.

ideas.title: The Personal Trading Card
ideas.summary: Collectible illustrated card with playful stats and a special power.
ideas.suitable_if: A few playful, harmless traits or skills are known to turn into stats and a special power.

ideas.title: Tiny Digital Snow Globe
ideas.summary: Interactive snow globe with click/shake particles, ambient audio, a personal miniature scene.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; a personal miniature scene makes it special when a cherished place is known.

ideas.title: Weekly Avatar Evolution
ideas.summary: Same avatar returns in a new outfit or environment each week.
ideas.suitable_if: An avatar gift already exists (or will) and the recipient enjoys collectible series.

ideas.title: Winter Desktop and Phone Wallpaper
ideas.summary: Quality wallpapers in favorite aesthetic and proper device aspect ratios.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; a favourite aesthetic or device is a bonus.

ideas.title: Your Pixel Avatar
ideas.summary: Personalized pixel avatar/character, optionally playable, based only on opted-in traits.
ideas.suitable_if: Opted-in traits (hairstyle, glasses, favourite jacket, hobby props) are known.

ideas.title: Your Project as a Creature
ideas.summary: Monstrous mascot for a project or other cherished undertaking.
ideas.suitable_if: A project or other cherished undertaking (a garden, a band, a thesis) is known well enough to give it a personality.

ideas.title: Ambient Soundscape
ideas.summary: Custom relaxation mix: a cabin at night, fireplace, snowfall, rain or another selected world.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; a chosen world (cabin, rain, fireplace, snowfall) matched to taste makes it personal.

ideas.title: Cinematic Mini Trailer
ideas.summary: Short original video trailer for something the human cares about, if video tools exist.
ideas.suitable_if: Video tools (or a canvas-to-WebM pipeline) exist and something the recipient cares about is known.

ideas.title: Fake Radio Broadcast
ideas.summary: One-minute fictional winter news report or interview about the human.
ideas.suitable_if: Harmless, shared facts about the recipient can become fictional "news"; a robot voice or a written transcript is acceptable.

ideas.title: Music-Box Melody
ideas.summary: A tiny animated music box that plays a short original melody.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; a quiet, universal gift that needs little context.

ideas.title: Original Holiday Song or Track
ideas.summary: A complete original instrumental or vocal recording tailored to interests and mood.
ideas.suitable_if: Interests and mood are known; the recipient enjoys music. Works with the built-in synth, no paid service required.

ideas.title: Personalized AI Carol
ideas.summary: Original holiday carol with words and optionally a recording.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient enjoys carols or singalongs; names, places and rituals are known for the words.

ideas.title: Short Personal Jingle
ideas.summary: Quick catchy original tune about a benign life moment or accomplishment.
ideas.suitable_if: A benign life moment or accomplishment is known (the new bookshelf, the half marathon).

ideas.title: The Fake Documentary Video
ideas.summary: Rendered mock documentary, beyond just a script, if video tools and budget permit.
ideas.suitable_if: Video tools and budget permit a rendered film, and a mockumentary theme is already strong.

ideas.title: A Letter from Future You
ideas.summary: Fictional, kind letter from the person in a chosen future year, such as December 2027.
ideas.suitable_if: Hopes, plans or values the recipient has shared can be gently projected into a chosen future year.

ideas.title: A Present for Your Pet
ideas.summary: Pet-themed portrait, fictional story, or small game, only if pet context exists.
ideas.suitable_if: Only if pet context exists: the pet's name, species and a few traits are known.

ideas.title: A World Made for You
ideas.summary: Small explorable fictional setting or immersive story using favorite themes.
ideas.suitable_if: Favourite themes, genres or settings are known.

ideas.title: Handwritten-Style Card
ideas.summary: Carefully composed personal note rendered as a beautiful readable card.
ideas.suitable_if: Always suitable; the one gift that needs no special context, only honesty.

ideas.title: Poem in a Specific Form
ideas.summary: Haiku chain, limerick, sonnet, spoken-word poem or original short verse.
ideas.suitable_if: Always suitable; choose the form to match the recipient's taste and the day's mood.

ideas.title: The Book You'd Write
ideas.summary: Invented book cover, blurb, opening chapter based on creative tastes.
ideas.suitable_if: Creative tastes (genres, authors, themes) are known.

ideas.title: The Compliment You Didn't Expect
ideas.summary: Thoughtful appreciation grounded in known behavior, not generic praise.
ideas.suitable_if: Known behaviour (not stated traits) can be appreciated specifically; the agent has observed something real.

ideas.title: The Things You Actually Accomplished
ideas.summary: Visual scrapbook celebrating verified progress without invented achievements.
ideas.suitable_if: Verified progress is available (a log, repos, a shared list of wins) so every entry is real.

ideas.title: The Tiny Celebration
ideas.summary: Animated celebratory page for a small genuine achievement.
ideas.suitable_if: A small, genuine achievement is known (a plant survived, a drawer got organised).

ideas.title: Year-in-Review Micro-Story
ideas.summary: Cozy story starring the person or fictional proxies, reflecting on their year.
ideas.suitable_if: Enough shared events from the year are known to shape a plot, or fictional proxies can carry a gentle reflection.

ideas.title: A Tool You'd Actually Use
ideas.summary: General-purpose personalized timer, converter, checklist or tiny app.
ideas.suitable_if: A small daily need is known (a tea timer, a unit converter, a packing checklist).

ideas.title: Personalized Coupon / IOU
ideas.summary: Redeemable agent promise such as create a story or plan a day; only for actions it can actually perform.
ideas.suitable_if: The agent can genuinely perform the promised action later (write a story, plan a day, build a tool) with the tools it has.

ideas.title: The Annoyance Killer
ideas.summary: A small approved utility removing a genuinely repetitive annoyance.
ideas.suitable_if: A genuinely repetitive annoyance is known and the recipient approved building small utilities; the utility runs sandboxed in the gift.

ideas.title: The Forgotten Feature
ideas.summary: A sandboxed demo or proposal for a neglected feature; coding-context only.
ideas.suitable_if: Coding-context only: a neglected feature or issue of the recipient's own project is known.

ideas.title: The Magic Shortcut
ideas.summary: Useful shortcut, script or workflow suggestion for something repeated.
ideas.suitable_if: Something the recipient repeats is known and a shortcut, script or workflow could save real time.

ideas.title: The One-Click Generator
ideas.summary: Small functional template generator that saves repetitive work.
ideas.suitable_if: A repetitive piece of work with a clear template is known (invoices, meeting notes, lesson plans, D&D encounters).

ideas.title: The README Makeover
ideas.summary: Proposed beautiful README improvement; software-project context only.
ideas.suitable_if: Software-project context only: the recipient has a project with a README that could shine.

ideas.title: The Secret Improvement
ideas.summary: Reviewed proposed patch or workflow improvement; never silently edits real data.
ideas.suitable_if: A reviewed patch or workflow improvement is possible and the recipient has approved proposals for a specific project.

ideas.title: Your Personal Cheat Sheet
ideas.summary: Beautiful reference card for something frequently researched or done.
ideas.suitable_if: Something the recipient frequently researches or does is known (a tool, a recipe technique, a language).

ideas.title: Your Personal Dashboard
ideas.summary: Tiny dashboard about a permitted project, hobby or personal interest.
ideas.suitable_if: A permitted project, hobby or interest has data the recipient agreed to use (reading log, garden notes, training).

ideas.title: A Night somewhere
ideas.summary: Research a suitable overnight stay, route, dates, seasonal access, pricing and booking link; recipient books/pays.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient's region, mobility, budget sense and travel preferences are known; a real stay can be verified with live pricing and seasonal access.

ideas.title: Collectible Winter Drink Recipe Card
ideas.summary: Beautiful collectible recipe card for a festive drink.
ideas.suitable_if: Almost anyone; tastes (sweet, spiced, caffeine, alcohol) make it personal.

ideas.title: Daily Holiday Recipe and Pairing
ideas.summary: Cooking steps and optional matching drink, chosen for dietary constraints if known.
ideas.suitable_if: Dietary constraints are known or the recipe is safely universal; the recipient cooks.

ideas.title: The 24-Hour Challenge
ideas.summary: Small achievable playful challenge with tracker, never manipulative.
ideas.suitable_if: A playful, small challenge fits the recipient's day (no phone before coffee, draw one thing, say hello to a stranger).

ideas.title: The Micro Adventure
ideas.summary: Real nearby outing presented as a whimsical quest with practical information.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient's area is known and a real nearby outing (a hill, a museum, a lake) can be verified with practical details.

ideas.title: The Mystery Walk
ideas.summary: Local walk with small riddles and a final surprise, using reliable route information.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient's general area is known, reliable route information is available, and walking is accessible to them.

ideas.title: The New Hobby Roulette
ideas.summary: Interactive roulette of accessible hobbies the person might enjoy.
ideas.suitable_if: Some interests and constraints (space, budget, time) are known so the hobbies are genuinely accessible.

ideas.title: The Scavenger Hunt
ideas.summary: At-home or local hunt with clues that require no unsafe activities.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient's home or local area is known well enough to write fair clues; the hunt stays safe.

ideas.title: The Secret Recipe
ideas.summary: Recipe with personalized name, plausible instructions and a fun backstory.
ideas.suitable_if: Tastes or dietary notes are known; cooking is something the recipient enjoys or wants to try.

ideas.title: The Stranger's Recommendation
ideas.summary: Unexpected book, film, game or place with a specific reason and a real link when needed.
ideas.suitable_if: Tastes are known well enough to pick something unexpected but fitting, and the recommendation can be verified to exist.

ideas.title: The Weekend Side Quest
ideas.summary: Fun achievable offline mission matched to actual interests and constraints.
ideas.suitable_if: Actual interests and constraints (time, budget, mobility, companions) are known.

ideas.title: A Custom Enamel Pin
ideas.summary: Original pin artwork + realistic preview + production specification + vetted vendor + ordering path.
ideas.suitable_if: A small icon-worthy idea from the recipient's world exists, and a pin manufacturer can be vetted with minimum order and estimated cost.

ideas.title: Custom Merch
ideas.summary: Real merch design plus usable print-on-demand vendor or ready-to-upload production asset.
ideas.suitable_if: A design idea rooted in the recipient's interests exists and a print-on-demand vendor can be named with a usable path.

ideas.title: The Book You Didn't Know You Needed
ideas.summary: Specific title and verified retailer/library links, price if available.
ideas.suitable_if: Reading taste is known and the title can be verified with retailer and library links.

ideas.title: The Experience Gift
ideas.summary: Relevant workshop, exhibit, lesson or experience with bookable link and actual conditions.
ideas.suitable_if: Interests and location are known; a relevant workshop, exhibit, lesson or experience can be verified with a bookable link and real conditions.

ideas.title: The Gift for Someone Else
ideas.summary: Thoughtful gift idea for a known recipient or pet; protect third-party privacy.
ideas.suitable_if: A known recipient (partner, friend, child, pet) is explicitly in scope and their privacy can be protected; the idea stays modest and verified.

ideas.title: The Hobby Upgrade
ideas.summary: Well-matched small practical item with specific purchasing details.
ideas.suitable_if: A hobby and its current gear are known so a small practical upgrade is well matched and within the price ceiling.

ideas.title: The Maker's Present
ideas.summary: Small kit or hobby materials with real items and purchase links.
ideas.suitable_if: A hobby or a desire to make something is known and the kit or materials can be verified with real items and links within the ceiling.

ideas.title: The Mystery Box
ideas.summary: Curated purchasable bundle with line-item prices and vendor links; no payment by agent.
ideas.suitable_if: Tastes and the price ceiling are known; several small items can be curated with line-item prices and vendor links.

ideas.title: The Perfectly Obscure Object
ideas.summary: Specific quirky item with verified vendor, price, listing, availability where possible.
ideas.suitable_if: Tastes and the price ceiling are known; a specific quirky item can be verified with a real vendor, listing and price.

ideas.title: The Printable Present
ideas.summary: Actual 3D-printable or printable craft file with fabrication guidance.
ideas.suitable_if: The recipient has (or has access to) a printer or 3D printer, and a craft or object fits their taste.
